description: This file contains partial class definitions, interfaces, and extension methods related to Orleans ADO.NET storage providers, including configuration options, storage implementation, storage hashing, and service registration extension methods.

classes.name: AdoNetGrainStorageOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for ADO.NET grain storage, including connection string, serializer, hash picker, and initialization stage.

classes.name: AdoNetGrainStorageOptionsValidator
classes.description: Validator class for AdoNetGrainStorageOptions ensuring configuration correctness.

classes.name: DefaultAdoNetGrainStorageOptionsHashPickerConfigurator
classes.description: Post-configuration class for setting up the hash picker for AdoNetGrainStorage options.

classes.name: AdoNetGrainStorage
classes.description: Implementation of IGrainStorage using ADO.NET, handling reading, writing, and clearing grain state with support for lifecycle participation.

classes.name: IHasher
classes.description: Interface defining a hash provider with a description and hash function.

classes.name: IStorageHasherPicker
classes.description: Interface for selecting a hasher among multiple hash providers based on grain and storage context.

classes.name: Orleans3CompatibleStorageHashPicker
classes.description: Hash picker compatible with Orleans 3 storage hashing mechanisms.

classes.name: OrleansDefaultHasher
classes.description: Default implementation of IHasher using a standard hash algorithm.

classes.name: RelationalStorageProviderQueries
classes.description: Encapsulates SQL queries used for storage operations.

classes.name: StorageHasherPicker
classes.description: Concrete implementation of IStorageHasherPicker that manages a collection of IHasher and selects one based on context.

methods.name: UseOrleans3CompatibleHasher
methods.description: Sets the storage hasher to be compatible with Orleans 3 hashing mechanisms in AdoNetGrainStorageOptions.

methods.name: ValidateConfiguration
methods.description: Validates that the AdoNetGrainStorageOptions are correctly configured.

methods.name: PostConfigure
methods.description: Post-configuration step for setting up options, typically for setting default hash picker.

methods.name: AddAdoNetGrainStorage
methods.description: Extension methods to register AdoNet grain storage with dependency injection, supporting default or named configurations.

methods.name: AddAdoNetGrainStorageAsDefault
methods.description: Registers the AdoNet grain storage provider as the default one in the Silo builder.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates an instance of AdoNetGrainStorage given a service provider and storage name.

methods.name: PickHasher
methods.description: Selects an appropriate hasher for a given grain and storage context.
